All:
# Some people have strong feelings about their city/town and state. Others
# don’t have such strong feelings. We are trying to measure these feelings
# among different people in Oklahoma. Can you tell us how much you agree or
# disagree with the following statements? There are no right or wrong
# answers; just give us your gut feeling. I am attached to Oklahoma.
#
# S3OK Public Survey, University of Oklahoma Institute for Public
# Policy Research and Analysis. Rebuilds this chart from the public
# wave files and nothing else.
# Wave 4.

library(tidyverse)
library(srvyr)

# Read as character: a column that is empty for its first thousand rows
# is otherwise guessed logical, which turns every real value after it
# into NA.
wave_4 <- read_csv(
  "Public_Wave_4_Survey_Data.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)

d <- bind_rows(
  wave_4 |>
    transmute(
      p_id,
      resp = okfeel_att
    )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(resp))

# The survey is a panel, so one person can answer in several waves. The
# design clusters on the panelist: percentages are unweighted shares of
# responses, and the intervals allow for repeated answers.
est <- d |>
  as_survey_design(ids = p_id) |>
  group_by(resp) |>
  summarise(
    p = survey_prop(proportion = TRUE, vartype = "ci"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

est <- est |>
  mutate(
    p = 100 * p, p_low = 100 * p_low, p_upp = 100 * p_upp,
    resp = factor(
      resp,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      labels = c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neither agree/disagree",
                 "Agree", "Strongly agree")
    )
  )

ggplot(est, aes(x = p, y = fct_rev(resp))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = p_low, xmax = p_upp),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap(paste(
      "Some people have strong feelings about their city/town and",
      "state. Others don’t have such strong feelings. We are",
      "trying to measure these feelings among different people in",
      "Oklahoma. Can you tell us how much you agree or disagree",
      "with the following statements? There are no right or wrong",
      "answers; just give us your gut feeling. I am attached to",
      "Oklahoma."
    ), 70),
    x = "Share of respondents (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
